# Copilot Instructions for This Repository

This project's conventions, execution rules, repository shape, and dev workflow
are defined in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — read it first, every session.

Before writing or modifying anything under `src/`, also read
[`specs/workflow.md`](../specs/workflow.md) and
[`specs/memory.md`](../specs/memory.md) for durable decisions, both of which
`AGENTS.md` points to.

Do not duplicate rules here. If Copilot-specific behavior ever needs to diverge
from `AGENTS.md`, add it below this line — otherwise keep this file a thin
pointer to avoid drift between `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `GEMINI.md`.
